
{{alias}}()
    Returns a list of aggregate transform operations.

    Returns
    -------
    out: Array<string>
        List of aggregate transform operations.

    Examples
    --------
    > var out = {{alias}}()
    [ 'count', 'valid', 'missing', 'distinct', 'sum', 'product', 'mean', 'average', 'variance', 'variancep', 'stdev', 'stdevp', 'stderr', 'median', 'q1', 'q3', 'ci0', 'ci1', 'min', 'max', 'argmin', 'argmax', 'values' ]

    See Also
    --------
